title: Acceptance and notification
summary: Notice of acceptance communicates to the offeror that the invited response has occurred. Whether notice is required, and when, depends on the offer and the method of acceptance.
notes:
An offer seeking a promise ordinarily requires an appropriate communication, unless the offer dispenses with it. International Filter treats executive approval as the prescribed accepting act and reads the form as dispensing with additional notice. Performance-only offers present a different question because the act may itself complete acceptance; the readings examine circumstances in which the offeror would not promptly learn of it. Keep acceptance, notice, and the time at which each takes effect separate.

International Filter’s specified approval dispensed with separate notice, though its letter would have sufficed. White required an appropriate manifestation placed in a reasonable course of communication. Carlill infers that the advertisement dispensed with advance notification of performance. Bishop requires notice where the offeror would not promptly learn of the act. Distinguish notice of a return promise from notice that invited performance has occurred.
